report.summary: Checkout-service resident memory rose 1.7× (711.46 MiB → 1225.50 MiB) over a 3‑hour window with no corresponding ERROR/WARN logs mentioning memory, indicating a likely memory leak or sustained high load.

likely_causes.title: Memory leak in checkout-service
likely_causes.rationale: The sustained 1.7× increase in resident memory without any error or warning logs suggests that the service is allocating memory that is not being released, i.e., a memory leak.

likely_causes.title: Increased traffic or workload causing higher memory usage
likely_causes.rationale: A sudden spike in concurrent requests or larger payloads can raise memory consumption even if the code is correct.
